description: Ratios computed from a company's latest snapshot by formulas with stable ids (bank.roe, corp.roic). Every value gives its unit, period and the snapshot figures it was computed from, each with its value and source document ids. Banks use the bank template (quarterly values annualised; Mizuho under Japanese GAAP, the other banks under US GAAP or IFRS on the measures their statements give); other companies use the corporate template (annual, quarterly and trailing four quarters, ttm), which includes credit metrics, liquidity, earnings quality and forensic scores; scores, credit reconciliations and the liquidity cover also give their parts, named with their coefficients in the catalogue. A value computed with an estimated input, such as the lease cost of the latest fiscal year for quarters that do not report it, names it in estimates; a ratio that a rule leaves out for the company gives the reason in excluded. Call without ratios to list the catalogue of one frequency.

at.description: an ISO date: answers when the snapshot that was the latest on that date is the latest one, since ratios are published beside the latest snapshot only

category.description: keep one category, for example Profitability or Credit metrics

compact.description: true for the values with their units only, without the conventions, the catalogue entries, the inputs and the citation format

company.description: company id from search_companies, for example apple or mizuho

from.description: first period: a fiscal year (2024), a fiscal quarter (FY2024 Q2) or an ISO date

limit.description: maximum values, those of the latest periods kept (default 120)

ratios.description: ratio ids or short names, for example ["roe", "corp.operating_margin"]; leave empty for all

to.description: last period, in the same forms

name: get_ratios
title: Get financial ratios
